prompt_text: Who is the best roofer in Denver for hail damage repair?
answer_verbatim:
I can’t name a single undisputed “best” roofer for Denver hail damage (that depends on your exact needs), but I can help you find the right contractor and avoid common pitfalls. If you want, I can also pull top-rated local options if you give a ZIP code or neighborhood.

How to pick the best roofer for hail damage
- Get multiple bids (at least 3). Compare scope of work, materials, and itemized pricing — not just the bottom line.
- Check licensing and insurance. The contractor should carry Colorado contractor’s licenses (if required), worker’s comp, and general liability insurance. Verify the insurance is current.
- Look for storm-damage experience and insurance-claim familiarity. A roofer who regularly works with insurers and document claims clearly will usually move the process faster and avoid claim denials.
- Verify manufacturer certifications. Certifications from GAF, CertainTeed, Owens Corning, etc., indicate training and access to better warranties.
- Read recent local reviews (Google, Yelp, Angi, BBB) and ask for 3 local references with similar hail repairs.
- Ask about warranties. Get both workmanship and product warranties in writing and understand what voids them.
- Confirm permit handling and cleanup. The contractor should pull permits (if required) and remove nails/leftover materials; insist on a final inspection.
- Beware of storm-chasers. Red flags: high-pressure sales, “special storm-only” pricing, demands for large upfront cash payments, or contractors who don’t have a local office or verifiable references.
- Payment and contract details. Never sign a blank contract. Avoid paying the full amount up front; typical schedules are deposit + progress payments + final payment on completion and inspection. Get lien releases for subcontractor payments.
- Document everything for your insurer. Take time-stamped photos, keep written estimates, and get all agreements in writing.

Questions to ask potential roofers
- How many years doing hail-damage repairs in Denver?
- Are you licensed/insured? Can I see certificates?
- Are you certified by a shingle manufacturer? Which?
- Do you handle insurance paperwork and claims?
- Can you provide 3 recent local references and before/after photos?
- What warranties do you offer? Is there a workmanship warranty in writing?
- Who will be on site and how is the project supervised?
- How do you handle unexpected damage or change orders?

If you’d like, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood and I’ll look up top-rated hail-repair roofers in Denver and summarize their ratings, notable certifications, and any BBB records.
